details:
I am a content creator who purchased VRC+ to use the camera dolly in a film project, and I noticed some problems. We can start by talking about smoothing, points, and paths, briefly explaining, each path would be a set of camera points, executed in ascending order. Theoretically, the paths would be independent sets in relation to general settings, but smoothing treats them as a whole. So, for example, from path 1 to 2, if I want path 1 to be “in out quad” and path 2 to be “out expo,” I will have a hard time because it is only possible to choose one of them.

Another thing would be about time marked by duration. Theoretically, it would be a simple task, specifying at each point of the path how long it should take to reach the next one, but this does not work very well. I believe this is also because of the addition of smoothing. Saying that I want to mark 15 seconds on path 1, I had to leave one camera at 10 seconds, another at 9, and the other two at 5, saying that it is a 4-point path. There is also no way of precisely tracking a path or camera time in general, as I believe that Camera Dolly does register in decimals, but you have a slider to play with. It would be better to be able to type or at least see the decimals like 1.2 or 0.3 and others. 

Also I'ts not really a problem, but when you get more than 5 paths in one room it starts to get really confusing to track what does each one do, and its easy to "missclick" deleting points as if I want to destroy path 4 path 3 is automatically set in but this is just more superficial stuff.
title: Camera Dolly problems and possible solutions
